storage_path.description: Root directory where all primary data files are stored.

cache_enabled.description: Enable caching of frequently accessed data for improved read performance.

cache_path.description: Directory used for caching data (ignored if caching is disabled).

cache_max_size_mb.description: Maximum allowed size of the cache in megabytes. Older entries are evicted when limit is reached.

worker_threads.description: Number of threads dedicated to background storage operations like compaction and cleanup.

volumes.description: List of storage volumes (backing stores). Each volume is a separately mountable storage unit.

path.description: Filesystem path where this volume is mounted.

read_only.description: If true, no writes are allowed to this volume.

quota_gb.description: Maximum logical size (in GiB) allowed for data stored in this volume.

tiers.description: Optional tiered storage configuration. Higher-priority tiers are used first when writing.

name.description: Name of the tier (used as section header, e.g., [tier:ssd]).

path.description: Filesystem path for the tier’s data.

priority.description: Priority (lower = higher priority). When writing, data is routed to the lowest-priority tier that has space.
